about: The contention proxy's model and the i9 cells it is checked against. Measured on the i9-10900K: the open-return bundle (evidence fa9707e9, open-return/run-20261118T210422Z.tar.gz: verdict.txt and dram.txt, unpinned, 12 rounds, Wikidata x4) and bench-imc-ten (evidence fa9707e9, imc-ten/run-20261118T090842Z.tar.gz: report.txt). One parameter is fitted (kappa), on the `fitted` cell alone; every `held-out` cell is a prediction.

sources.dram_latency_points: bench-imc-ten report.txt, wikidata-x4: L3-miss latency 548.7 cycles at mibz2-occ-7-28, 649.0 at mibz2-occ-10-40 (medians), measured, not fitted
sources.llc_kb: the i9-10900K's 20 MiB L3, shared by the workers
sources.kappa: the L3-hit latency's rise in cycles a further worker: fitted by `moonshot.py calibrate` on opend 7/28 against lazy at 7 workers only
